messages.permission: Your preview role cannot perform this leave action.
messages.allocation: No leave allocation exists for this employee and leave type. Ask HR to configure it.
messages.balance: The requested debit exceeds the available leave balance.
messages.date: Select valid dates in order, within the configured maximum duration.
messages.quantity: Enter 0.5 to 366 days in half-day increments.
messages.length: The reason or contact text exceeds the permitted length.
messages.notice: The dates fall outside the configured application window.
messages.overlap: This employee already has an active request overlapping these dates.
messages.nonworking: This range contains no chargeable working days. Select working dates or an explicit half-day quantity.
messages.missing: The leave request is no longer available.
messages.stale: This request changed. Review its current status before trying again.
messages.status: This action is unavailable for the current leave status.
messages.earlyReturn: Leave has already started. Ask HR to process an early return.
messages.saved: Leave application recorded in database successfully.
messages.preview: Enterprise leave workflow: applications, balances, and multi-tier approval audit records are persisted in Neon PostgreSQL.
messages.allocationType: Allocate a configured paid leave type. Comp-off requires a dated credit grant.
messages.adjustment: Enter a non-zero adjustment between -366 and 366 days in half-day steps.
messages.adjustmentReason: Provide an adjustment reason of at most 2000 characters.
messages.employee: Select an employee with an explicitly configured preview identity.
messages.monthlyLimit: The requested debit exceeds the workbook monthly limit for this leave type.
messages.eligibility: This leave type requires eligibility and allocation configuration before requests can be accepted.
messages.reference: This reference request needs ledger reconciliation before it can be changed.
messages.birthday: Birthday leave eligibility requires a recorded date of birth and dates within the birth month.
messages.joined: Leave cannot start before the employee joining date.
messages.band: This employee band is not eligible for the selected leave type.
messages.waitingPeriod: This employee has not completed the configured eligibility waiting period for this leave type.
messages.combination: Casual leave cannot be combined with earned or sick leave in one continuous absence. Select dates separated by a working day.
messages.creditDate: Comp-off requires enough earned credits that remain valid on each requested leave date.
